Formalized the FRAME principle: deck shell (grid, persistence, menus, bridge) is kind-agnostic; proved repeatability by adding a new kind — link cubes — via the 5-step recipe (feed file -> parser -> renderer -> behaviors -> interactions), with feeds/links.md bullets ({{ROOT}} expansion) becoming open/copy URL cubes

Saved WHITE_PAPER.md (fourth canon doc) and implemented its governing rule — the Commit gate: Reference ≠ Representation, verified live. New bridge endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE /deck, GET /decks) commit the layout to portable .state/kiss/decks/<name>.json (atomic write); a Commit ▾ toolbar menu names, commits, lists, and loads deck files. Agent cubes now carry AICube provider/model fields from the white paper data model. Sharing section: none → seeded (deck files)

Stored the canonical Machine Sections data-flow diagram (diagrams/machine-sections-flow.png) and annotated each product station (Drag'n Drop Kit / Zustand / Firestore / share token) with its real prototype binding (startDrag/snap/handleDrop, deck-store + 400ms debounce, localStorage + bridge deck files, portable .json)

Built the Writer plate — STFU+WRITE Phase 2 (Writer Without AI) — on the frame: Writer preset with the six functional cubes (WRITE/PROJECT/SOURCE/VOICE/EDIT/OUTPUT), five modes (FLOW/FREEWRITE/EDIT/REFERENCE/OUTPUT) that remap the grid like a sonar faceplate (Ctrl+1..5), a real writing surface bound to .md drafts via the bridge (typing = representation only; Ctrl+S saves to drafts/, Ctrl+E exports .md+.txt to drafts/export/ — non-destructive Lightroom rule verified end-to-end: no file until explicit save), word count, PROJECT drafts manager (new/list/open). Fixed two bugs found in testing (writer preset falling into the full-deck branch; draft filename sanitizer stripping .md)
